legend: It is the year 2222. The whole universe has been explored, and settlements have been built on every single planet. You live in one of these settlements. While life is comfortable on almost all aspects, there is one dire problem: the latency on the internet connection with other planets is way too high.

Luckily, you have thought of a solution to solve this problem: you just need to put Bonded, Astronomically Paired Cables between all planets, and internet will be super fast! However, as you start developing this idea, you discover that constructing a cable between two planets is more difficult than expected. For this reason, you would like the first prototype of your cable to be between two planets which are as close as possible to each other.

From your astronomy class, you know that the universe is best modelled as a large cube measuring $$$10^9$$$ lightyears in each dimension. There are exactly $$$10^5$$$ stationary planets, which are distributed completely randomly through the universe (more precisely: all the coordinates of the planets are independent uniformly random integers ranging from $$$0$$$ to $$$10^9$$$).
Given the random positions of the planets in the universe, your goal is to find the minimal Euclidean distance between any two planets.
input: One line with an integer $$$n$$$, the number of planets.
$$$n$$$ lines, each with three integers $$$x$$$, $$$y$$$, and $$$z$$$ ($$$0 \leq x, y, z  \lt  10^9$$$), the coordinates of one of the planets.
output: Output the minimal Euclidean distance between any two of the planets.
Your answer should have an absolute or relative error of at most $$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: 现在是 2222 年。整个宇宙已经被探索完毕，每一颗行星上都建立了定居点。你生活在其中一个定居点里。尽管生活的几乎所有方面都很舒适，但仍有一个严峻的问题：与其他行星连接互联网时的延迟实在太高了。
幸运的是，你想到了一个解决这个问题的办法：只要在所有行星之间铺设天文配对电缆，互联网就会变得超快！然而，当你开始着手实现这个想法时，你发现，在两颗行星之间铺设电缆比预想的困难。为此，你希望第一条电缆原型能铺设在距离尽可能近的两颗行星之间。
从天文学课上，你知道宇宙最适合用一个每个维度长为 $$$10^9$$$ 光年的大立方体来建模。宇宙中恰好有 $$$10^5$$$ 颗静止的行星，它们完全随机地分布在宇宙中(更准确地说：所有行星的坐标相互独立，且都是从 $$$0$$$ 到 $$$10^9$$$ 均匀随机选取的整数)。
给定这些行星在宇宙中的随机位置，你的目标是求任意两颗行星之间的最小欧几里得距离。

input.ai: 一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$，表示行星的数量。
$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含三个整数 $$$x$$$、$$$y$$$ 和 $$$z$$$($$$0 \leq x, y, z  \lt  10^9$$$)，表示其中一颗行星的坐标。

output.ai: 输出任意两颗行星之间的最小欧几里得距离。
你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不应超过 $$$10^{-6}$$$。
